scientific_integrity: Proof and actual finite-matrix checks are supplied. Earlier equal-length dark-state results are antecedents, not new discoveries; independent mathematical and originality review remain outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Finite path-armed spiders with uniform positive nearest-neighbor hopping, zero onsite energies, and one central imaginary loss. Exact long-time no-jump single-particle survival only; no relaxation-time theorem, nonuniform coupling, dephasing, or many-particle Lindbladian claim. Priority comparison is nonexhaustive.
title: Arithmetic dark-state and site-selective absorption laws on unequal-arm quantum spiders
